top_signals.title: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
top_signals.summary: Wall Street and investors will be looking for Netflix to provide additional details about the company's strategy following recent organizational changes
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
top_signals.summary: The FBI and cyber agencies in the UK and Germany said SafePay is targeting businesses and critical infrastructure by guessing passwords, exploiting vulnerabilities and using phishing attacks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
